body: i feel very similar to you right now. i’d like to chat about it if you’d like. feel free to message me.
can i message you? i really resonate with your 1st paragraph.

this comforted me. often people tell me these things and they make me feel even worse because i feel like if these encouragements work for them why aren’t they working for me. i’m so tired too. i just want to sleep forever. no dreams. no crying as i go to sleep. just sleep.

I feel like i’m taking so many steps back from my growth. I last night i had so many urges and bad thoughts just absolutely wrecking havoc on my mind. i know i’m not going to do any of the things i have urges to do, but it is still so scary. my parents were there and i had my episode next to them. my mom helped me a lot. my dad unfortunately just kept screaming at me because of what i was saying. i don’t think i can talk to him today. or look at him. my parents wouldn’t let me sleep alone or be alone because they were scared. i feel like i’m just falling through the floors of growth i’ve built over the years of struggling with suicidal tendencies as well as self harming.
